name: @shepherd/ext-shell
description: shepherd.shell — the rail row for terminals that belong to no task.
//exports: The split every extension makes: main imports ./manifest to register, the utility process imports the root. There is no ./ui — a tree is data, not a component.
//agents-core: A DEV dependency, and only a dev one, because the ONLY thing taken from it is the `AgentState` type — boundaries.js allows a type import of another extension and refuses a value import. A runtime dependency entry would claim an edge that does not exist.
//shepherd: The manifest, as an extension declares it. `src/manifest.ts` is the typed copy the host loads, and `manifest.test.ts` asserts the two are identical.
